description_en: Invokes the UpdateTrafficMirrorFilterAttribute operation to modify the configuration of a traffic mirror filter
description_zh: 调用UpdateTrafficMirrorFilterAttribute接口修改流量镜像筛选条件的配置信息
kebab_example: aliyun vpc update-traffic-mirror-filter-attribute --traffic-mirror-filter-id tmf-j6cmls82xnc86vtpe0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateTrafficMirrorFilterAttribute

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the traffic mirror filter
parameters.help_zh: 流量镜像筛选条件的实例ID
parameters.name: traffic_mirror_filter_id

parameters.help_en:
The new description of the traffic mirror filter.

The description must be 1 to 256 characters in length and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`
parameters.help_zh:
需要修改的流量镜像筛选条件的描述。

描述长度为1～256个字符，不能以`http://`或`https://`开头
parameters.name: traffic_mirror_filter_description

parameters.help_en:
The new name of the traffic mirror filter.

The name must be 1 to 128 characters in length and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`
parameters.help_zh:
需要修改的流量镜像筛选条件的名称。

名称长度为1～128个字符，不能以`http://`或`https://`开头
parameters.name: traffic_mirror_filter_name

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The ClientToken value can contain only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the RequestId value as the ClientToken value. The RequestId value of each API request is different
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId可能不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run. Valid values:

true: performs a dry run without modifying the configuration of the traffic mirror filter. The system checks the required parameters, request format, and business restrictions. If the request fails the dry run, an error message is returned. If the request passes the dry run, the `DryRunOperation` error code is returned.
false (default): sends a normal request. If the request passes the dry run, a 2xx HTTP status code is returned and the configuration of the traffic mirror filter is modified
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求，取值：

true：发送检查请求，不会修改流量镜像筛选条件的配置信息。检查项包括是否填写了必需参数、请求格式、业务限制。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，则返回错误码`DryRunOperation`。
false（默认值）：发送正常请求，通过检查后返回2xx HTTP状态码并直接修改筛选条件的配置信息
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the traffic mirror filter.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html operation to query the most recent region list. For more information about the regions that support traffic mirroring, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/207513.html
parameters.help_zh:
流量镜像的所属地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID。关于流量镜像支持的地域，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/207513.html
parameters.name: region_id
